gaps.reason: The bytes of an xlsx zip container carry their own timestamps and the pdf branch depends on whether reportlab is installed. The status, content-type and Content-Disposition are pinned; the body is '@binary' with '@any' size and digest. The excel branch is additionally captured as a 500 for list-valued cells, which is what the events scope actually produces.
_excel_dump falls back to _csv_dump when the import fails; the capture environment has openpyxl 3.1.5, so the fallback arm is not exercised.
The expiry arm needs the 5-minute TTL to elapse. Freezing the clock would change what the comparison means, and sleeping 300 s in a generator is not a contract. Not captured.
check_permission_auth() accepts a monitor bearer token instead of an admin session when the secret is configured. The fixtures pin the unconfigured profile (admin session required).
Requires two live approvals whose eight-character hints collide; the hint is derived from a random token, so it cannot be forced without patching the token generator.
The `available: false` arm needs the app built without a hardening status provider, which create_app() always supplies.
